description: In the heart of Vienna, a series of art thefts has left the city in turmoil. As whispers of a notorious art thief resurface, you must navigate through a web of deception and hidden motives. Each suspect holds a piece of the puzzle, but only one is the true mastermind behind the heists. Can you unravel the truth before the thief vanishes into the shadows once more?
